description_full: KDDI Corporation engages in the provision of mobile telecommunications services in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, Personal Services and Business Services. The Personal Services segment offers 5G telecommunication services and other services, such as finance, energy, and LX through its multi-brands comprising au, UQ mobile, and povo; and entertainment services, including video to individual customers. The Business Services segment provides smartphones and other devices, network, and cloud services; and data center services to corporate customers under the TELEHOUSE brand name. It is also involved in the provision of solutions for the development and expansion of businesses through IoT, DX, generative AI, and other technology centered on 5G communications. In addition, the company sells mobile handsets. KDDI Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

financial_summary: KDDI Corp. is a large-cap communication services business with a $64.7B market cap on $38.3B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -1% over the past three years — essentially flat, and a business treading water is rarely a path to compounding.
Returns on capital run at 9% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically, with gross margins sitting at 43%.

The business throws off $7.0B in free cash flow — roughly 18 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.53× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 2.2× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage of 31× is fortress-like.

Management returns a meaningful 6.8% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 21% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
